aboutGame.title: What is Slop Tower Defense?
paragraphs: Slop Tower Defense is a Roblox strategy experience where players summon and craft units, then build a defense against enemy waves.
Its progression revolves around expanding a unit roster, choosing useful team roles, and adapting your defense as new seasons, raids, and game modes arrive.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Slop Tower Defense.

items.question: What is Slop Tower Defense?
items.answer: Slop Tower Defense is a Roblox strategy experience built around summoning and crafting units, then defending against enemy waves.

items.question: How do I get free towers in Slop Tower Defense?
items.answer: Start by using the summon and crafting systems, then build a roster that helps you defend the waves available in your current game build.

items.question: What is the SLOP code in Slop Tower Defense?
items.answer: SLOP is the code currently published on the official Slop Tower Defense experience page and provides a cash reward.

items.question: Which units are best in Slop Tower Defense?
items.answer: The best choice depends on the active waves and your roster. Compare damage, area coverage, support, and economy roles instead of relying on one permanent ranking.

items.question: Where can I find Slop Tower Defense updates?
items.answer: Check the official Roblox experience page, the Slop TD! Roblox Community, and the public Discord linked from the community guide.
